Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Sanjay - 32 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Meenakshi - 58 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Nitin - 66 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Sanjay stands in the living room. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Sanjay: "Today feels like a good day."

[Sanjay pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Sanjay (laughing): "Yes, of course."

[Sanjay wraps a bandage around his bleeding hand.]

Meenakshi (excited): "That's easy."

[Sanjay presses a cloth to the wound to stop the bleeding.]

Meenakshi (happily): "That's easy."

[Sanjay jumps in his seat at the scary scene.]

Sanjay (surprised): "Mom, look at this."

[Sanjay throws a bucket of water on the fire.]

Sanjay: "I really enjoyed today."
